properties.decision:
**RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL.** From flo2's feedback of 2026-09-14, relayed by Anthony: "the setters could report a displaced role the way prose_currency reports stale prose." Recorded after the specific defect was fixed at its cause (roles as a set), because the ask outlives the defect.

═══ THE ASYMMETRY ═══
A node upsert that replaces properties preserves the prior state in `snap:epoch:preserved-on-write:<id>` and returns a `revision` block naming each property replaced and its prior value — "nothing is lost and the history is right". An EDGE upsert (`create_edge` on an existing (type, from, to)) replaces the properties wholesale, preserves nothing, and returns the new edge. Every relationship property in the design is therefore the ONE kind of record whose overwriting leaves no trace — and AUTHORED_BY's author-displaced-by-approver went unseen from August to September for exactly that reason.

═══ OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
**(a) Symmetry: edges get preserved-on-write and a `revision` block.** The reply then says "this write replaced role=author acted_at=2026-08-04". ⚠️ Counter: edges are re-drawn idempotently far more often than nodes are re-created (every acknowledgement re-draws GOVERNED_BY; every reconcile re-draws REALIZES), so a snapshot per re-draw is real growth; the revision block would need to say "unchanged" cheaply and snapshot only on a real change.
**(b) Report but do not preserve.** The reply names what it replaced; nothing is stored. ⚠️ Counter: the reply is read by an agent that may not relay it, and a lost reply (fact:defect-a-one-shot-stdio-session-loses-the-reply…) loses the only record.
**(c) Nothing general — make each accumulating property set-valued as it is found**, which is what AUTHORED_BY got. ⚠️ Counter: it fixes the ones somebody notices, and the sweep that would find the rest has not been done.
**(d) A detector rather than a write-time report**: compare_designs-style, "an edge property changed value between two exports". ⚠️ Counter: only as good as the export cadence, and it is what flo2 already has by accident.

═══ WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS DECIDABLE ═══
The sweep in fact:lesson-edge-identity-excludes-properties…: how many edge properties are "accumulate" rather than "change". If it is only `roles`, (c) is done and this can close; if it is several, (a) is the fix that covers the ones nobody has noticed yet.
properties.name: OPEN — should an edge upsert preserve the prior edge and report what it replaced, the way a node upsert already does? flo2's ask, generalised — and the reason the displaced-author defect was invisible for six weeks
properties.rationale: Recorded as an idea, not a ruling, on the day the specific instance was fixed — so the general question is not lost in the relief of the specific fix. flo2 asked for the reporting; the cause-level fix made the reporting moot for this one property and left the asymmetry standing for every other.
